searchText: Hello <@827653956955406406> so I did looked into rpctestgen and the problem of spec-disconnected, client-biased test validation is already solved. The .io test files are validated directly against the OpenRPC spec for structural correctness, using a client-independent tool (cmd/speccheck), ensuring spec-conformant tests The only thing I can see/ suggest is that we wire up cmd/spec heck to run automatically after test generation so we need to extend its features I guess this is the reason we had this issue, we need to make it run immediately after the test generation Either we have it in the CI which am not sure how the CI work flow currently works or as a pre-commit hook But I think we should have it integrated directly into the test generation process for instant feedback(this makes most sense) great work! glad to hear it is present, just broken. I'll add that as a discussion point for next meeting - in my opinion, having the speccheck run as early as possible AND as part of CI would be ideal. Alright
